notes.content:
[h2][b]  Improvements and Additions[/b] [/h2][list][*][p][i]Food stands are now persistent through restarts  
[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Credits gained from paystations are now persistent through restarts
 [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Owners/Managers of a shop may now send credits to their ATM for paycheck redemption and collection at any time post-transaction
    [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Added many more food stands to Nightmare
   [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Banker Anamnecyte cost adjusted: 6 -> 3 
[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Buffed food created/cooked by players
   [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed Casino property name [b]   
[/b][/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Readded Casino paystation
 [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Adjusted Dealer/Banker Night Market discount: 10% -> 25%

[/i][/p][h3]To end off, a message from our C.M:

[i]"We've listened to the polls, and we're going to be making changes in our dev-ops. 

Small updates will be released over-time instead of lumping them in with major updates. Stay tuned. The stove is still on, we are indeed cooking. Give us time. To add to that, the dealer rework is NOT complete. We have some awesome systems ([b]shoutout to Tarandus[/b]) coming to fates which are going to change the flow of gameplay. The ideas from our community have been astonishing, and we will be adopting some of them into our internal discussions.   I want to take a minute to thank everyone for their immense feedback, constructive criticism is how we grow.       Going forward, we will be changing up Aneurism IV. Certain buffs/debuffs or changes of systems will be considered game-wide events, and will be published to ⁠🚨︱consul-transmissions within the Discord and in change-logs to keep things interesting. This could be anything from food shortages, to economical depressions.     Since moderating a community is not all that I want to do, I'm going to be more engaged in your Prole lives, whether for better, or for worse. Thank you for your continuing patience, we look forward to sharing more as time goes on, including some exciting news about neutral fates soon to join your experience in Aneurism IV." - A.C  [/i][/h3][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 16: The Midnight Update
notes.content: [h1]The Midnight Update[/h1][p]Citizens of ANEURISM IV, have you heard of the Midnight Bloc? They've just settled in ANEURISM IV and have revolutionized business as we know it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970972/8a9a8cbb73a0065136851339637f3008f09d3c5f.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Heads‑Up on what’s next[/b][/h2][p]Version  16 is the opening move in Aneurism’s biggest overhaul yet. Its new systems are groundwork for version  17, which will bundle the fresh [b]Misery[/b] map with the long‑awaited apartment rework.[/p][list][*][p]In [b]Nightmare[/b], food stands will appear alongside Paystations.[/p][/*][*][p]In [b]Misery[/b], food stands will replace Paystations entirely.[/p][/*][/list][p]Nightmare is moving to “legacy” status as we adopt a streamlined map‑development pipeline that promises far greater stability and performance. We’ll keep a few official servers running Nightmare for die‑hard fans, but most servers will shift to Misery once version 17 lands. You can find some pictures of the upcoming Misery map on our [url="https://instagram.com/vellocetcorp"]Instagram[/url] page.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970972/89197181ad715827e2de5cb0300cefedc8455ecc.png"][/img][/p][h1]Changelog[/h1][h2]New Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added the Night Market[/b], which complements the DealerNet. It functions as a reverse‑DealerNet where players pre‑pay with credits, receive a receipt code, and pick up their goods once any Dealer/Banker fulfils the order (fulfiller receives the tax; buyer gets a waypoint).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Food Stands[/b][i]: [/i]stall‑style vendors that let shop‑owners sell food shipments at their own prices. Shipments are restocked via the Night  Market.[/p][/*][*][p]Added shipments: Gabagool, Sausage Rolls, and Canned Bread are now available as shipments through the DealerNet.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new music track.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Renamed Dealer Pickups to Dead Drops for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how DealerNet functions to support the new Night Market/Shipment workflow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added more slave spawns.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved property system efficiency and reliability.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Applied anti-theft system to eating, drinking, and grabbing.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Paystation and Food Stand payouts are now taxable income and therefore must be collected from Civil Terminals.[/p][/*][*][p]Non-Cortex weapons are now considered fully contraband and are therefore illegal to be in possession of the Cortex.[/p][/*][*][p]Gabagool, Sausage  Roll, and Canned Bread single items have been removed from the DealerNet (they are now obtained via shipments).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added burning air hazard to Volos Precinct[/b] (affects all fates except Slave).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slave corpses now despawn faster.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Suspicious Meat only drops from players who have been alive for > 5 minutes.[/b] (Proles take time to ripen)[/p][/*][*][p]Properties can now only be renewed after 50% of the lease time has passed.[/p][/*][*][p]Cortex patrols will now award 20% anamnecyte gain (Increased from 10%).[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug with properties where incorrect info would be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bugged ore node in the mining area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed turret glitching.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed recoil control when inverted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed workbench interaction window on ultrawide monitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched conditions that lead to illegal item interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved user authentication security.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved anti-theft system logic.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched transport to Brazil.[/p][/*][/list][h2]System & Server Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]VIP Slots: Servers now support a VIP role that bypasses the player cap. [i]Use -reservedslots argument on the command line (default  4).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New command: cleanupitems \[user id] – destroys all items grabbed by the specified user[/p][/*][*][p]New command: cleanupitems – destroys all grabbable items[/p][/*][*][p]New command: changemap – switches to the specified map[/p][/*][*][p]New command: startgamemode – reserved for future use[/p][/*][/list][h1]Final notes[/h1][p]We're very glad to introduce this update. The team is working very hard on the next coming versions and we just need a little more time to make sure they're in a good spot before we release them. Your patience will be rewarded! In the meantime, enjoy some well-deserved patches and gameplay improvements to Aneurism IV.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, make sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/vellocet"]Discord[/url] server! We frequently post sneak-peeks on upcoming updates, and it's the first place to receive big announcements![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/vellocet" style="button"]Join our Discord server[/url] [url="https://instagram.com/vellocetcorp" style="button"]Follow us on Instagram[/url][/p]

notes.title: We're Back.
notes.content:
[h3][b]Proletariats, welcome back.[/b] 

  Very simple announcement to keep our steam community up to speed- Attacks have halted, and [b]we are going to be undergoing investigations[/b] into these bad actors and malicious attackers (butthurt cheaters). 

  Servers are back online for now, update will be coming soon, keep a close look at our announcements!

   Thank you for giving us your time, patience, and endurance through this unfortunate time. We look forward to getting you back to work. [/h3][p][/p][p]-A.C


Under laws like the [b]Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (US)[/b] and the [b]Computer Misuse Act (UK)[/b], DDoS attacks can result in [b]heavy fines and prison time[/b], sometimes up to 10 years. 
Similar laws apply in many countries around the world. We are actively investigating and will pursue any responsible parties through proper legal channels. 
If you're running a community or affiliated server and have [b]traffic logs from the time of the attacks[/b], please reach out. That information could be extremely helpful in our investigation.

 [i]— Vellocet Staff[/i][/p]

notes.title: On The Subject of Server Issues.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970972/5a2b0096b5da6a4851e0a81ca9f3c235c50776b4.png[/img]

[h1][b]Good evening, Proletariats.[/b][/h1] 

We've given a lot of information on our discord about the recent problems, but we'd like to address them here to our community that may not use the discord platform. 

Unfortunately, this is all we have at this time when it comes to Shockbyte.  https://status.shockbyte.com/cmbiasjn00007gdb03njbl02q 

We have received no updates since then. We are going to be having a major internal meeting tonight on the subject of finding suitable solutions for our community. We're just as upset as you guys are, we do promise. 

In the meantime, we would like to encourage everyone to A. Bring up your own personal community server, or B. Take some time to enjoy community servers in general! 

Aneurism IV operates by community, and so do its devs. We're not dodging the problem by pushing you away to other servers whatsoever, but we know you will have a better experience in community servers opposed to the alternative intermittent issues we have been experiencing. 

Thank you for playing our game. We apologize for the disruptions wholeheartedly and we know it may take some time to show that, but we are prepared to get to work and improve upon our players' experiences on Aneurism IV. 

Thank you for your attention. 

(Copied announcement from Discord server status, you can view it at discord.gg/vellocet

- A.C

notes.title: Version 14d
notes.content:
Citizens of ANEURISM IV!

This may look like a routine update, but don’t be fooled. While we’re always working on fresh content behind the scenes, stability remains our top priority. What seems small on the surface is actually a big step forward under the hood. We hope you enjoy the improvements!

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Portuguese localization.
[*] Steam profiles can now be opened from the players tab.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased software stability improvements. 
[*] Improved handwritten font for better legibility/cyrillic support.
[*] Player IDs can be copied from the players tab and from bulletin board posts.
[*] Server performance improvements.
[*] Improved cosmetic validation.
[*] Simpler/more reliable civil ID generation based on join order (i.e.: first player will have ID #1000).
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed liquidator skinning.
[*] Fixed conditions that could lead to gaining unintended anamnecytes.
[*] Improved reload times.
[*] Fixed invalid credit symbol.
[*] Added better support for unicode characters.
[*] Fixed edge issues that allowed for users to duplicate items.
[*] Fixed conditions that could lead to a crash.
[/list]
[h2]System & Server Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a global ban list which community servers can optionally subscribe to.
[*] Ranks file can now be stored externally.
[/list]

[i]Note: All databases have been wiped for this update.[/i]

notes.title: Version 14c
notes.content:
Greetings proud workers.

For the past few weeks, we've been working on lots of new content. Many have asked for a roadmap, but the truth is we don't know when what is coming. All we know is that a lot of good stuff is coming — from the notorious apartment update to a complete metalworks rework. But like all good things, these take time.

Thankfully, we know the citizens of ANEURISM IV value their time. That's why we're rewarding their patience with 8 new cosmetics, and some much needed bug fixes and improvements.

Lastly, we've almost hit [b]10 000 members[/b] on our [url=https://discord.gg/vellocet]Discord[/url] server. Thank you to everyone for all your support. We can't wait to celebrate the big 10k!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970972/b7f9bb51c74b88f980d16d0a86c28730cf90e8fb.png[/img]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] 6 new cosmetics for Zealot & Liquidator.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added some additional clipping to prevent exploiting the map.
[*] Improved server browser reliability & added logs for helping those with issues.
[*] Disallowed jumping if the player cannot stand up.
[*] Adjusted player collision capsule size when crouching.
[*] Improved death logic to prevent losing points in the afterlife.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Changes & Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an inventory cooldown for picking up items to stop thiefs (applies currently to ration factory, distillery, and inventory). This is only part 1 of our efforts to stop stealing. Part 2 will include the metalworks rework. Shoutout to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@chroma_Prime]Chroma Prime[/url] once again.
[*] Buffed Vomit Coffin.
[*] Adjusted loot drop rate.
[*] Increased Liquidator anamnecyte cost from 4 to 6.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Psychostatica now correctly prevents sanity loss when witnessing deaths.
[*] Possibly solved some issues with cosmetics being incorrectly applied to models.
[*] Possibly fixed loading crate locking bug.
[*] Fixed sprinting animations when holding weapons.
[*] Fixed diagonal strafing animation.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 14a
notes.content:
Greetings citizens of ANEURISM IV. We bring to you today a super tiny but important patch.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update Steamworks for better Proton & Windows support. This in theory should solve the empty server browser issue.
[*] Attempted to fix rare crate signature locking bug.
[*] Fixed inability to become Vomit Coffin when having less than 0 anamnecytes.

Thanks for suffering with us in ANEURISM IV. The team will now get back to work on [b]version 15[/b]...

Also, don't forget to follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/vellocetcorp]Instagram[/url] to keep up with the latest sneak peeks.

notes.title: Version 14: Rotten Update
notes.content:
Citizens of ANEURISM IV, stay alert. The Cortex has seen a critical surge in rot levels.

Unfortunately, the [b]Rotter's Update[/b] took a bit longer than expected. It turns out that a few of the "developers" got sick, and one was even transformed into a strange new creature they call a [b]Vomit Coffin[/b]...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970972/6b7b29a6848fe0bf3a154f6c8003704ad5a085cc.png[/img]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] New fate: Malpractitioner.
[*] New fate: Vomit Coffin.
[*] Added laced drugs.
[*] Added a mute menu which lists all players that can be muted.
[*] Added Brain Scorcher secondary fire mode.
[*] Added 8 new cosmetic items.
[*] Added more ledges in the map for better movement.
[*] Added 2 properties to Femoral Station.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved Czech and Russian localization.
[*] Improved Limitator & Dealer model.
[*] Improved server browser reliability.
[*] Improved commendation logic.
[*] Spirits can no longer touch boulders.
[*] Minor movement improvements.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Changes & Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Refined justified kill logic and ensured that antagonists can no longer freely kill each other (thanks to Chroma Prime for the video about this).
[*] Increased fish spawn rate.
[*] Removed hijacker from DealerNet.
[*] All contributors will be rewarded when signing a loading crate.
[*] Removed door breaching during limitation orders.
[*] Increased number of cradles in each greenhouse to 6.
[*] Buffed Ahti.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed commendations not having any effect.
[*] Fixed reverb zones incorrectly affecting certain audio parameters such as footstep volume and pitch.
[*] Fixed loading crate lock bug.
[*] Fixed Rogue not being able to use Combat Juice.
[*] Fixed bonecorn material.
[*] Fixed rare inventory issues.
[*] Fixed various minor issues such as invalid Civil IDs.
[*] Fixed incinerator issue where players would be forced to disconnect.
[*] Fixed an issue where karma wouldn't recover if the player had max anamnecytes.
[*] Fixed server browser crashing under Proton.
[*] Fixed official server names.

notes.title: Version 13: Fabric of Society Update
notes.content:
The Fabric of Society update introduces a [b]cosmetic system[/b] with 45 new garments to drape over your hollowed-out husk—because if society’s crumbling, you might as well look decent on the way down, right?

More importantly, we’ve finally [b]solved the dreaded rubberbanding issue[/b] that has plagued ANEURISM IV for so long. Movement is smooth, network stutters are gone, and the entire database system is now fully asynchronous, resulting in a massive performance leap. This is a foundational update—expect faster systems, sharper threads, and fewer ways to cheese the taxman. We'd like to thank everyone who helped us test this bug update. We really appreciate your help and support!

notes.title: Spring Roadmap - We're hard at work!
notes.content:
Citizens of ANEURISM IV,

The Consul is thrilled to witness the excitement and enthusiasm you've shown for ANEURISM IV! We, the proud workers behind this unique project—[i]the dev team[/i]—are deeply grateful for your continued interest and support.

For those who may be new, ANEURISM IV has been passionately under development for nearly three years. We sought out to create an immersive, one-of-a-kind project, and it fills us with pride to see our community engaging so actively and positively with our city.

ANEURISM IV is a living, breathing city that thrives through constant evolution, and thus deserves regular enhancements and expansions. To keep our citizens informed and excited, we've introduced the [i]System Upgrade Procedure[/i] timer on the main menu, allowing you to eagerly anticipate our [b]bi-monthly content updates[/b].

We have a wealth of exciting features lined up for you. Here's just a small preview of what's coming this Spring:

[list]
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Persistent Property System – Own and customize your apartments!
[*]Expanded Clothing System
[*]Alcohol and Distillery Mechanics
[*]New Weapons and Tools
[*]Networking and Performance Optimizations
[/list]

Thank you for being an essential part of ANEURISM IV’s growing community, and stunned—great things are on the horizon!

That's all folks! Tune into discord.gg/Vellocet for live changelogs and development updates! Thank you for being a loyal worker to the Cortex's mission! Also, make sure to drop us a follow on the store page in order to stay up to date on new changelogs and game events.

Glory To Aneurism IV. 

-A.C

notes.title: Gameplay Update - August 2024
notes.content:
[i]Proletariats, the Cortex has issued an immediate change to the isolation status of our district. Standby for transmission.[/i]

Hello everyone! Here's some long-awaited patch notes for August 2024, Some entries may include updates from other changelogs we wanted to highlight. 

Features/Modifications: 

- [u][b]Contraband in paystations may now be confiscated by Cortex fates[/b] [/u]
- [b]Contraband may no longer be taken out of/put into public lockers[/b]
[b]- New Storage Container[/b] - [i]"Scum Lockers" may be used to store contraband, like the personal locker but with the ability to store contraband components/equipment. [/i]
- Soil no longer vanishes anymore after it is used in a pot
- [b]Slave fate added[/b]
- Raised frequency of game events 
- Music will periodically play [from v0.3.4a] 
- [b]Advertisement cost/post adjustment [may be posted up to 4 days, cost is now 6 credits per hour] [/b]
- Improved various sounds
- [b]Liquidators get rewarded for refilling generators [/b]
- Added civil center near laundromat [v0.3.3]
- Added shop near laundromat [v0.3.3]
- Added bulletin board [v0.3.3]

Patches/Bugfixes: 
 
- [b]Rot spores are now (hopefully) unable to go into inaccessible areas now[/b]
- [b]Adjusted rot changes to accustom to Proles not doing their job as the Cortex demands [/b]
- [b]Suisoda will now consume itself properly[/b]
- Fuel refinery has been hotfixed
- Fixed server's radio station playlist 
- [b]Skinning corpses will affect the rot level properly[/b]
- [b]Slave boulder spawns fixed[/b]
- [b]Rot node spawns fixed[/b] 
- [b]Fixed various exploits[/b]
- [b]Fixed bug causing "ghost items" to appear in inventory[/b]
- [b]Adjusted certain player stats[/b]
- Improved death/spawn sequence
- Improved sparks sound
- Changed compilation method to improve performance (let us know if you see a difference!)
- Added rate limitors to certain expensive methods on the server

That's all folks! Tune into discord.gg/Vellocet for live changelogs and development updates! Thank you for being a loyal worker to the Cortex's mission! Also, make sure to drop us a follow on the store page in order to stay up to date on new changelogs and game events. 

Glory To Aneurism Four. 

- A.C
